A Q3 provision of (5) is a credit-loss benefit, not a USD 5 million expense. Pretax and net income rose while the total nonperforming-loan stock and commercial-real-estate component also rose; an unqualified credit-quality improvement conclusion is unsupported.
The adjacent numeric columns contain other quarters and issuer-calculated changes. The first numeric current-quarter or current-as-of value in each frozen report was selected.
Selected rows do not audit reserve adequacy, charge-offs, loan balances, capital ratios, full footnotes, or the cause and recurrence of the provision benefit.
